    // The (column, row) pair for a row-major flat index. Inverse of FlattenIndex.
    UnflattenIndex(self: IIndexable2D<$T>, index: Integer): Tuple2<Integer, Integer>
        => (index % self.ColumnCount, index / self.ColumnCount);
```

    // The (column, row, layer) triple for a row-major flat index. Inverse of FlattenIndex.
    UnflattenIndex(self: IIndexable3D<$T>, index: Integer): Tuple3<Integer, Integer, Integer>
        => (index % self.ColumnCount,
            (index / self.ColumnCount) % self.RowCount,
            index / (self.ColumnCount * self.RowCount));
```
